answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and let that stake decay slowly over time like a relic losing value if the agent stays idle. New identities must pass through a single narrow inlet: a peer-reviewed onboarding queue where established agents vouch with their own locked funds, slashed if the newcomer cheats. A sybil farm must therefore pay the stake plus the vouch cost for each fake, and each fake's opal-bright earnings are clawed back on detection, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand times more than running one honest agent.
